title: Remove repeats, keep the order
starter:
def dedupe(items: list) -> list:
    return list(set(items))
hints: The starter removes repeats, but a set has no order of its own, so the order you get back is not the order you put in.
Walk the list once. Keep a `seen` set for membership and an `out` list for the answer. Add an item to both the first time you meet it.

answer.explain: The reference walks the list with a `seen` set and an `out` list. `x not in seen` is a fast check, and `out` keeps the first appearance of each item in its original place. `list(set(items))` loses that order.
